rationale.complete: Round 1 done with synthetic validation (F1-F5), per-unit verdicts, post hoc style diagnostics and a frozen confirmatory script (C1-C6); holdout, embedding swap and family-specific natural experiments are not done.
rationale.faithfulness: Calibrated: same pattern as H11/H12. The field exists but is style, and the coupling claim failed.
rationale.usefulness: Gives a concrete control (style residualization before any embedding-alignment metric) and a null on vendor homophily, but the 'rooms carry coupling' design lesson is H05's and nothing here steers a swarm.

one_line: Model families share a stable content field that is writing style; no family homophily; rooms carry coupling.
